df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)

    # Get column names

    columns = cursor.fetchall()
    print(f"Columns in table: {[col[1] for col in columns]}")

    print("\nSample total_employees_ever values:")

    # Show total count of rows
    count_query = "SELECT COUNT(*) as row_count FROM workday__organization_overview"
    count_df = pd.read_sql_query(count_query, conn)
    print(f"\nTotal rows in table: {count_df['row_count'].iloc[0]}")
    
conn.close()
